comparison.objective: Fit a brake caliper containing thicker pads over a disc, versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual caliper alignment and constrained insertion over the rotor versus recessed-tool engagement, retained-collar adjustment, counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Caliper seating without pad/disc damage is title-implied; no body/specs, clearance, seating, or fastening rubric is available. Candidate requires two safe dynamic cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision and force control, but caliper fitment tests multi-part clearance insertion rather than response-based damping calibration.
